decisions.decision: Executor isolation forced to none (sequential on the main working tree) for the whole of Phase 23, with .planning/config.json left byte-identical
decisions.rationale: Worktrees cannot execute these plans: eval/.cache/ and .lz-research/ are gitignored, so a fresh worktree lacks the q1 captures and the AVeriTeC cache that plan preconditions HALT on, and MANIFEST writes into eval/.cache/ would be discarded with the worktree. Each wave holds exactly ONE plan, so worktree isolation buys no parallelism -- only the risk of git worktree remove --force recursing a symlinked cache and destroying threat T-23-06's irreplaceable data. Maintainer-ratified via AskUserQuestion; the config-untouched variant was chosen over persisting use_worktrees=false.
